verdict.rationale: Snyk ships its own LLM-driven Remediation Agent that a user can hand vulnerability-fixing work to: it scans the project, builds a fix plan, applies the fixes and verifies them, and can be started natively with `snyk fix --agentic` in the Snyk CLI. Delegation is limited to remediation, though. The MCP server and `/snyk-fix` commands run inside third-party coding assistants, so they do not count as a built-in assistant, and DeepCode AI autofix is a feature rather than an assistant you delegate to. missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant beyond remediation, an in-app (web portal) assistant interface, independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent's behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The Remediation Agent is an LLM-driven tool that automates vulnerability remediation in your projects. It scans your Project with Snyk, generates a fix plan enriched with Snyk security intelligence, applies the fixes, and verifies the result
Run `snyk fix --agentic` from your terminal to trigger a human-in-the-loop interactive remediation experience without an IDE.
all in your coding assistant or the Snyk CLI.
